shape: Square arena with TWO entry hubs (N+S gates)
description: Two-portal square combat arena. Unlike paru-A ib1's single-center-anchor pattern, this stage has TWO entry hubs — one just inside each portal — and each hub independently connects to the four corner-detour anchors plus a shared center anchor. So either gate can dispatch to any corner without crossing through a single bottleneck. Direct N↔S transit goes hub → center → hub.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-6.03, -24.84) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.south: spawn_south at (3.91, 24.73) — gate on the south (high-Z) side

anchors.description: north entry hub, joins north_gate and dispatches to all corners + center (matches uvotpk)
south entry hub, joins south_gate and dispatches to all corners + center (matches rmyx7i)
geometric center — shared transit anchor between the two hubs (matches kkcmve)

traversalNotes: Direct N↔S: spawn_north → north_inner → arena_center → south_inner → spawn_south. Four hops.

DISPATCH RULE: any corner objective routes via the entering side's inner hub. Walk current_gate → current_inner → corner → current_inner → next_inner → next_gate. The two hubs DON'T directly link — transit between them always passes through arena_center (or a corner, but center is the canonical route).

Same primitive family as paru-A ib1 (two-portal square arena) but with an asymmetric hub layout that gives each portal its own dispatch staging area. Use the entering-side hub for objectives — don't cross to the far hub just to reach a corner.
